spec.join: _staletail_arm_cells harvests the four tail aggregates, each era on both the relative and the raw key, the artefact block and the E74 answers; the artefact event LIST travels as a date face (its top print) because a count that moves without the names moving is a different finding
spec.control: the same arm joined against itself; every cell must read delta 0.0 or the join machinery moved the numbers
spec.guard_vs_repair: guarded columns = the tail E74 actually priced (events with no >30% single-session jump inside their span); unguarded = the all-events and artefact block beside it

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.delta_units: counts are events; bp columns are basis points; negative_share is a fraction; years is a duration -- the summary max is a screen over mixed units, not a quantity
answers.reading: the repair reaches the stale tail: 19 of 77 cells move (3 guarded, 8 unguarded, 8 other) and 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only
answers.honest_flag: guarded columns moving is the finding that matters: E74's guard is a >30% single-session jump test, while panel_screen repairs integer-ratio prints -- two different populations, and a delta here means the tail was quoting a set the screen never touched

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the screened arm repairs prints inside the panel it is handed; it does not add or remove bars, so an unchanged universe_members count is a property of the repair, not evidence the panel is clean

the artefact guard is a daily-limit screen, not an adjustment: an event it excludes is excluded on BOTH arms identically, so this leg can only show whether the repair reached the prints the guard missed
E74's era bp/yr divides a small total by a short span on the early eras; those cells move for arithmetic reasons as much as for repair reasons and are read beside their event counts
E97 counts the published numbers of this runner; the join covers the tail/era/answers cells and the top artefact print, not the full event list or the skipped-block counters
